FIX ROUND 1 (operator 123) — growth-project-backend#667 @ c5c86cb46bfe3f6ea425e255536a9ae091686580

Fixes the three red required checks named in the RD1 verdicts at af32412c (Sol 6007737817 APPROVE scoped / NOT MERGE-READY, Opus 6007753559 REQUEST CHANGES on checks only). Two commits since af32412c:

1. ec12f3a9 (test only, 4 files, +25 -11):
   - R75: test/roman/roman.controller.spec.ts makeRes() now builds `res` as an express Response (`Object.assign(Object.create(null) as Response, {...})`), so the six `res as never` at the sendMessage call sites are gone; test/roman/roman-context-core.spec.ts builds the intake prisma the same way instead of `as unknown as PrismaService`; test/roman/roman-context-a2-fixes.spec.ts maps its fixture rows through a typed `toSample` instead of `as unknown as Parameters<...>`. Local `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=range --base=76a59216 --head=ec12f3a9`: as unknown as net 0, as never net -4, "OK — no positive token change".
   - build-and-test: removed the stale `'src/roman/roman.service.ts': 1` legacy exception in test/privacy/no-pii-in-logs.spec.ts (the train removed that log; the scan finds zero).
   - Local: the four specs pass (56/56, heavy.sh jest); tsc --noEmit over the three Roman specs clean.
2. c5c86cb4: merge of backend main d5177b31 (b#738, proxy-addr 2.0.8). No conflicts; it changes only package-lock.json, which is not a #667 file (A5 rule 12 for this part). This clears the dependency audit gate.

READY FOR AUDIT (delta af32412c..c5c86cb4: the test-only commit; the merge is lockfile-only)
